title: 真假美猴王
subtitle: 伙伴记得真正的你
origin: 《西游记》第五十六至五十八回（低龄温和改编）

moral.zh: 真正的伙伴关系不只看外表，更来自共同经历、彼此信任和愿意合作；不必模仿别人，也能找到自己的光。
moral.en: True friendship is built on shared experiences, trust, and cooperation—not looks alone. You do not need to copy someone else to find your own light.

pages.zh: 离开女儿国后，师徒走进一片安静树林。刚才那阵笑声又响起，连悟空自己也愣住了。
pages.en: After leaving the Women's Kingdom, the travelers entered a quiet forest. The same laugh echoed again, surprising even Wukong.
pages.prompt: Use the established traveling-team visual anchor while fully restating every visible core character. Tang Seng is a gentle young monk with a smooth round face and warm brown eyes, wearing a russet-and-gold kasaya robe over cream under-robes and a five-buddha crown; calm, kind, softly smiling; child-friendly rounded animated-film proportions. Zhu Bajie is a sturdy round-bodied pig-faced traveler with a soft rose-tan snout, rosy cheeks, large floppy ears, big warm brown eyes, and short black hair tied in a tiny topknot; he wears a dark teal cross-collar tunic with a cream inner collar, mustard-yellow sash, loose charcoal trousers, and black cloth shoes; he carries a rounded wooden-handled nine-tooth rake like a farm tool, never raised or pointed at anyone; food-loving, playful, warmhearted, never scary; child-friendly rounded proportions. Tang Seng and the others look curious, not afraid; all tools remain upright, lowered, or packed. Do not show the second monkey yet. pages.zh: 树后跳出另一个“悟空”，衣服、头环和金箍棒几乎一模一样。他说：“我也能当最厉害的悟空！”
pages.en: Another “Wukong” leaped from behind a tree, with nearly identical clothes, headband, and staff. “I can be the greatest Wukong too!” he declared.

pages.en: Tang Seng did not ask them to compete. Instead, he asked both to share a treasured memory. The real Wukong remembered the promise represented by his headband.

pages.en: White Dragon Horse helped too. He calmly approached the real Wukong, remembering how Wukong always stroked his mane before a difficult path.

pages.en: The group proposed a teamwork task: straighten a small bridge shifted by the stream. It was not about speed, but about listening to one another.

pages.zh: 六耳猕猴终于说：“我只是太想被夸奖，才一直模仿你。”他收起变化，穿回自己的蓝灰衣裳，露出两侧各三道小小耳褶。
pages.en: At last, the Six-Eared Macaque admitted, “I wanted praise so much that I kept copying you.” He dropped the disguise, returning to his blue-gray clothes and revealing three delicate ear folds on each side.

pages.en: Everyone welcomed Liu'er as himself. After helping place the final plank, he waved goodbye. In the distance, a red mountain shimmered with heat.
